paragraphs: SDL sells software for local government departments, and the site names SDL Desktop, SDL Connect, and GovSites as its products. Department pages cover request management, code enforcement, building permitting, community development, permits and licenses, land use, and government websites. Listed capabilities include digital applications, mobile inspections, workflows, citizen portals, plan reviews, and configurable forms.

The site describes the buyers as local governments, claiming over 260 local government clients and 26+ years of expertise. Named clients on that page include Township of Howell, City of New Brunswick, Broome County, and Town of Webb.

Support is described as in-house and US-based, with training and updates from a customer success team. The site says the solution can be fully implemented in as little as six weeks. A separate platform is described as letting residents connect directly with the department.

quote.text: SDL worked with us on a pricing structure we could afford and made it possible for us to modernize our small town technologies.
